Therefore, whenever it is possible for each one of you, hasten ye to those cities and shine forth like unto the stars with the light of the Most Great Guidance.

[CANDIDATE]
O ye states of the Eastern Hemisphere, like the states of Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, and Pennsylvania, some of you are indeed luminous existences, yet in some of your cities the light of the Kingdom has not yet shone forth, and they are ignorant of the teachings of Heaven. Therefore, if it be possible for each of you, that ye should strive to illuminate those cities, even as the stars send forth the light of their unfailing guidance.
